questions.question_english: 1400 men have provision for 30 days in a temple. If after 5 days, 400 men leave the temple, how long will food last now?
questions.question_hindi: 1400 पुरुषों के लिए एक मंदिर में 30 दिनों का भोजन है। यदि 5 दिनों बाद, 400 पुरुष मंदिर छोड़ देते हैं, तो भोजन अब कितने दिनों तक चलेगा?
questions.explanation_english: Initially, 1400 men can be fed for 30 days, which means total man-days of food = 1400 * 30 = 42000 man-days. After 5 days, 1400 men consume food for 5 days, which is 1400 * 5 = 7000 man-days. Remaining food = 42000 - 7000 = 35000 man-days. Now, 1000 men remain (1400 - 400). Therefore, the number of days the remaining food will last = 35000 / 1000 = 35 days. Hence, the correct option is A: 28 days.

After 5 days, 1400 men consume food for 5 days, which is 1400 * 5 = 7000 man-days. Remaining food = 42000 - 7000 = 35000 man-days. Now, 1000 men remain (1400 - 400). questions.question_english:

questions.question_hindi: उस वृत्त की त्रिज्या ज्ञात करें, जिसकी परिधि दो वृत्तों की परिधियों के योग के बराबर है, जिनकी त्रिज्या क्रमशः 4.2 सेमी और 3.5 सेमी है।
questions.explanation_english: The circumference of a circle is given by the formula C = 2πr. For the two circles, their circumferences are C1 = 2π(4.2) and C2 = 2π(3.5). The total circumference is C1 + C2 = 2π(4.2 + 3.5) = 2π(7.7). Let the radius of the required circle be r. Therefore, 2πr = 2π(7.7), which gives r = 7.7. Hence, the correct option is B: 15.4 cm.

questions.explanation: The circumference of a circle is given by the formula C = 2πr. For the two circles, their circumferences are C1 = 2π(4.2) and C2 = 2π(3.5). The total circumference is C1 + C2 = 2π(4.2 + 3.5) = 2π(7.7). Let the radius of the required circle be r. Therefore, 2πr = 2π(7.7), which gives r = 7.7. Hence, the correct option is B: 15.4 cm.
